title: Twist E20: Other small gluing primes and actual torsion modules
status_note: Proposed E20; not started. A generalized native module enumerator and actual-torsion checker are not yet implemented. A separate runnable protocol and source/checker pins are required.
blocked_on: note:A generalized native module enumerator and actual-torsion checker are not yet implemented.
question: Do gluing primes 5, 7, 11, 13 or 17 expose additional public-parameter candidates that the 3-torsion filter misses?
decision_value: A verified positive adds a specifically named construction candidate. An all-negative table excludes only this finite prime set. Rising map/construction costs are reported before expanding gluing degree.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB, 15 seconds per matrix cell; at most two explicit toy torsion constructions per prime with a 1,800-second cap each. No public large-prime torsion construction is included in this pilot. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.

outputs.result_schema: Not frozen; required evidence fields are in the linked design. No result exists.
